precommit_basis: The ordered protocol is the target-specific adoption of the rev-5.6 phase contract and the tracked S1_M_042 discovery terms; classifications and replay evidence are recorded separately.

canonical_target.normalized_claim: For every number field K, every smooth proper geometrically connected curve whose concrete structure-sheaf H^1 has additive dimension at least two has finitely many K-rational sections.

sources: content-bound public-project observations already tracked by the same-theorem family dossiers
historical formal-system boundary and the tracked target source crosswalk
Gerd Faltings, Endlichkeitssatze fur abelsche Varietaten uber Zahlkorpern, Inventiones Mathematicae 73 (1983), 349-366, DOI 10.1007/BF01388432

alias_families: rational points on curves over number fields

selection_rules.exact: The candidate must preserve arbitrary number fields, the concrete frozen scheme/cohomological curve hypotheses, all rational sections, and finiteness, or provide an independently checked transport.
selection_rules.supporting: Definitions, statement shapes, genus interfaces, height/Northcott/descent APIs, special cases, and audit booleans are classified independently and never receive root proof credit.
selection_rules.placeholder: A terminal or transitive body using sorry, admit, sorryAx, an unapproved axiom, unsafe injection, or an oracle is M5 for root-credit purposes.
selection_rules.negative_evidence: Every lane identifies an immutable or content-bound source, result, access boundary, and reopen condition. Access failure is not interpreted as a zero-result search.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, same-claim dossiers, and candidates sharing one terminal body are counted once for proof credit.

network_policy: denied for worker replay; no clone, fetch, update, dependency build, or moving-ref query is part of this inventory version
credentials_policy: No authenticated credential is required for replay. Historical unauthenticated access failures remain failures rather than negative results.
immutable_refresh_policy: A new immutable candidate or changed source, statement, graph, pin, or lane result creates a new append-only inventory version.
expected_negative_evidence: Each not-found, mismatched, placeholder-bearing, or access-failed result retains its source/query identity, revision or response binding, date boundary, and reopen condition.
credit_boundary: This protocol supports a bounded immutable anchor inventory only. It cannot supply H0, R0, a proof of MordellTarget, M0/M1, AUDIT-Z, theorem completion, release, provider acceptance, or master acceptance.
